author: Springer, 1940

note.en: A small hammerhead with a spade-shaped head that lives in shallow coastal water of the southwestern Caribbean; one record at Panama's Caribbean coast, none here. Critically Endangered and covered by Costa Rica's hammerhead protection.
note.es: Un tiburón martillo pequeño con la cabeza en forma de pala que vive en aguas costeras someras del Caribe suroccidental; hay un registro en la costa Caribe de Panamá, ninguno aquí. En Peligro Crítico y cubierto por la protección de martillos de Costa Rica.

evidence: No local record found; FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic (coast not stated)
iNaturalist: 1 research-grade record on Panama's Caribbean coast

sources.t: IUCN Red List: Sphyrna media, Critically Endangered

recWhy: No local record; one photo on Panama's Caribbean coast and a FishBase country listing.

marks.en: Hammer-shaped head with a shovel-like, rounded front edge and no deep notches; grey-brown above, pale below.
marks.es: Cabeza en forma de martillo con borde frontal redondeado como pala y sin muescas profundas; gris pardo arriba y pálido abajo.
